description_en: Recognizes elements contained in the input image, marks their positions with bounding boxes, and classifies their basic types (person/object, decoration, and text)
description_zh: 识别输入图中所包含的元素，用矩形框标注出其位置，并区分其对应的基本类型（人/物、修饰、文案）
name: DetectImageElements

parameters.help_en: Original image URL. Must be a publicly accessible URL with a maximum length of 8K
parameters.help_zh: 原始图片URL地址，必须是公网可以正常访问的地址，最长8K
parameters.name: url
